Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Product Description

Welcome to our store Active clothing shop



If you have any questions about the product, please contact the customer service and we will give you a satisfactory solution.



Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Welcome to our store Active clothing shop

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

Advantages of Active fabrics is stable and not easy to deform: The structure of the double-sided fabric makes it not easy to deform. Even after repeated washing and wearing, it can maintain a good version and is not easy to become loose or wrinkled.



Advantages of Active fabrics Better moisture wicking and breathability: The structure of the double-sided fabric can design styles with good moisture wicking and breathability, especially in some sports or outdoor T-shirts



Advantages of Active fabrics Increased durability: The double-sided fabric structure of the shirt makes the T-shirt stronger, improves wear resistance and durability, can withstand more tension and friction, and is not prone to wear and tear

2025-12-02 11:42 | Variation: Selene, Eclat, Good Girl

Effectiveness: The first thing you’ll love is how rich and concentrated the scent is. Because it’s oil-based, the fragrance clings beautifully to the skin and slowly releases the scent throughout the day. Hindi siya mabilis mag-evaporate like alcohol-based perfumes, kaya super long lasting perfect for humid weather or long days outside.

Fragrance: Smooth, well blended, and hindi matapang sa unang spray. The oil base makes the fragrance feel warm, elegant, and premium. Kahit affordable, amoy mamahalin talaga. The dry down becomes sweeter and softer over time, giving you that luxury perfume vibe.

Texture: Since oil-based siya, it’s less irritating than strong alcohol perfumes. Perfect for sensitive skin and for people who want a scent that feels comfortable, not harsh.

A fantastic choice for anyone who wants a long-lasting, premium smelling, and affordable perfume oil. Sulit siya sa presyo, and you’ll definitely get compliments when you wear it. Sakto for everyday use. The 50ml bottle is travel friendly, hindi mabigat dalhin, and looks classy on a vanity or bag.

c*****a

2026-06-02 17:28 | Variation: Vl4ya

Nathalie Claid Valaya is a fresh, clean, and elegant fragrance that gives off a luxurious “clean girl” vibe. The scent opens with bright citrus and soft fruity notes, followed by delicate floral accords that create a light and feminine character. As it dries down, it develops into a smooth musky scent that feels fresh, sophisticated, and perfect for everyday wear.



One of the things I like most about this fragrance is its versatility. It works well for school, work, casual outings, or even special occasions. The scent is not overpowering, making it suitable for people who prefer subtle yet noticeable perfumes. Considering its affordable price, it delivers impressive quality and a scent profile that resembles more expensive fragrances.

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.



God Bless! 🤍

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.



God Bless! 🤍

10ml Spray – Square Bottle

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.



God Bless! 🤍

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.



God Bless! 🤍

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.

Product Description

Nathalie Claid Eau De Parfum







10ml Spray – Square Bottle







A simple and elegant everyday perfume in a handy 10ml spray bottle. Perfect for daily use, travel, or as a gift.







Product Details:







• Eau De Parfum



• 10ml spray bottle



• Square bottle design



• Long-lasting scent



• Easy to carry and travel-friendly











Note:



Actual scent may vary depending on body chemistry. For best use, spray on pulse points such as wrist, neck, and behind the ears.







Thank you for supporting Nathalie Claid.

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

Product Description

"Mighty Clean Powder Detergent



Variant: Floral Blossom with Freshness of Fabric Conditioner



Net Weight: 1 Kilogram







Mighty Clean Powder Detergent helps remove dirt and stains while leaving clothes fresh and clean with the delightful scent of Floral Blossom and Fabric Conditioner. Perfect for both hand washing and machine washing.







✔ Effective stain removal



✔ Fresh Floral Blossom fragrance



✔ With Fabric Conditioner freshness



✔ Suitable for hand wash and machine wash



✔ Value-for-money laundry detergent for everyday use







Warning: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.







Hand Wash Instructions:



1. Ihiwalay ang puting labahin sa mga de-kolor.



2. Tunawin ang 2-3 kutsarang powder sa isang batya ng tubig.



3. Ibabad ng 20-30 minuto.



4. Banayad na kusutin.



5. Hanguin at banlawan.



6. Gamitin ang pinagbabarang tubig sa mga de-kolor.



7. Ulitin ang step 3-5.



8. Hayaang matuyo sa sampayan.







Machine Wash Instructions:



1.Ihiwalay ang puting damit sa mga de-kolor.



2.Tunawin ang 4-5 kutsara ng powder sa Low Water Level ng washing machine.



3.Ibabad ang 20-30 minuto bago simulan ang paglalaba.



4.Maaari nang isunod and mga de-kolor at gawin ang step 2-3.







This item is registered with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines under the trademark of Mighty Clean.







Mighty Clean – Matindi sa mantsa, Mighty-tipid sa bulsa!







Have a safe and clean home with Mighty Clean."

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material.

• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.

Product Description

20 Packs Wipes for Baby (1 pack 80 sheets)







Features:



• Made of cottony soft and thick material. 



• Specially formulated to be mild and gentle on your baby’s delicate skin.



• For babies: Keep baby fresh and clean. Use at changing time, playtime, at home or on the go.



• For the entire family, 



Eg. Make-up removal, travelling and sports.



• Non Alcohol







Directions:







• Open the cap and peel off sticker.







• Gentle pull out the wipe.



• Reseal sticker after each use or keep the cap close to retain the moisture.







Cautions:



• Keep out of reach of children.



• Keep away from direct sunlight or heat.
